candidates.name: Kiyomasa
candidates.description:
清正(Kiyomasa) is a community-led meme based on the real gorilla Kiyomasa, the son of Shabani, Japan’s famous “handsome gorilla.”

As the son of one of Japan’s most iconic gorillas, Kiyomasa carries real-world roots, strong Japanese identity, and a presence that stands out immediately. That is what makes this narrative feel different from just another meme.

Now being rebuilt by local Japanese community members, the project aims to grow into something positive, visible, and worth supporting.

candidates.name: Abel
candidates.description:
ABEL. The brother you never met.

You know the smile. You know the meme. But the internet only ever got half the story. Jotchua’s real name is Cain. And Cain has a brother: Abel.

They shared the same dirt, the same water bowl, the same blood. While Cain was busy becoming the poster child of the internet, Abel was right there in the yard. Abel doesn't want the crown. He’s not here to dethrone his brother, and he isn't trying to rewrite history. He just wants to be in the family photo.

For years, the world celebrated one half of a whole. Today, we’re putting the family back together. Welcome home, Abel.

candidates.name: three.ws
candidates.description: Three is a marketplace and runtime for 3D AI agents — autonomous characters that users can discover, deploy, and pay to interact with. Each agent lives in a fully rendered 3D environment powered by Three js and can be monetized by its creator through time passes, trials, and per-session payments using USDC and the x402 payment protocol. Creators can list agents on the marketplace, set pricing, and earn directly. Users browse the catalog, launch agents in-browser, and pay with their connected wallet, with no intermediary. The platform also includes a built-in wallet dashboard for balances, receipts, and withdrawals. Three is infrastructure for the agent economy: own, run, and earn from AI agents with real onchain payments.
